failures.root_cause: invoice_total converts each price to int before summing, discarding cents: 10.75 + 20.25 becomes 10 + 20 = 30 instead of 31.0.
The actual order ORD-7721 has region us-east-1, while the expected region is eu-west-1. The order_id and state match.

additional_reads: The compact pytest output abbreviated the order mismatch and omitted the legacy warning, so I reran the failing and legacy tests through rtk proxy with -vv. The compact settings diff explicitly truncated additions, so I read the full diff through rtk proxy and also checked staged changes. I read the full commit body through rtk proxy to verify completeness. Direct file reads supplied the invoice implementation, complete route definitions, and all deployments.
